verses.text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

translations.text: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
Qayamat ki ghadi kareeb aa gayi aur chaand phatt (split) gaya

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

translations.text: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
Magar in logon ka haal yeh hai ke khwa koi nishani dekh lein mooh moadh jaatey hain aur kehte hain yeh to chalta hua jaadu hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

translations.text: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
Inhon ne (isko bhi) jhutla diya aur apni khwahishat-e-nafs hi ki pairwi ki.Har maamlay ko Aakhir-e-kaar ek anjaam par pahunch kar rehna hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

translations.text: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
In logon ke saamne (pichle qaumon ke) woh halaat aa chuke hain jinmein sarkashi se baaz rakhne ke liye kafi samaan-e-ibrat hai

verses.text_uthmani: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

translations.text: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
Aur aisi hikmat jo nasihat ke maqsad ko ba-darja-e-atam (consummate wisdom) pura karti hain magar tambihat(warnings) in par kaargar nahin hoti

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

translations.text: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
Pas aey Nabi, insey rukh pher lo. Jis roz pukarne wala ek sakht nagawaar cheez ki taraf pukarega

verses.text_uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

translations.text: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
Log sehmi hui (down-cast) nigaahon ke saath apni qabraon se is tarah niklenge goya woh bikhri huyi tiddiyan (locusts) hain

verses.text_uthmani: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

translations.text: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
Pukarne wale ki taraf daudey jaa rahey hongey Aur wahi munkireen (jo duniya mein iska inkar karte thay)us waqt kahenge ke yeh din to bada kathin hai

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

translations.text: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
Insey pehle Nooh ki qaum jhutla chuki hai. Unhon ne hamare bandey ko jhoota karar diya aur kaha ke yeh deewana hai, aur woh buri tarah jhidka (rebuffed) gaya

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ

translations.text: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
Aakhir-e-kaar usne apne Rubb ko pukara ke “main magloob ho chuka , ab tu inse inteqam le”

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

translations.text: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
Tab humne mausla-dhaar baarish se aasmaan ke darwaze khol diye aur zameen ko phaad kar chasmon mein tabdeel kar diya

verses.text_uthmani: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

translations.text: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
Aur yeh saara paani us kaam ko pura karne ke liye mil gaya jo mukaddar ho chuka tha

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

translations.text: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
Aur Nooh ko humne ek takhaton(planks) aur keelon (nails) wali par sawar kar diya

verses.text_uthmani: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

translations.text: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
Jo hamari nigrani mein chal rahi thi .yeh tha badla us shaks ki khatir jiski na-qadri ki gayi thi

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.text: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
Us kashti ko humne ek nishani bana kar chodh diya, phir koi hai nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.text: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
Dekhlo, kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambihaat (warnings)

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, phir kya hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.text: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
Aad ne jhutlaya, to dekhlo ke kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambihaat (warnings)

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

translations.text: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
Humne ek paiham nahusat (unremitting misfortune) ke din sakht toofani hawa unpar bhej di jo logon ko utha utha kar is tarah phenk rahi thi

verses.text_uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

translations.text: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
Jaise woh jadd (roots) se ukhade huey khajoor ke taney (trunks) hon

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.text: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
Pas dekhlo ke kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambihaat (warnings)

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, phir kya hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

translations.text: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
Samood ne tambihaat ko jhutlaya

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

translations.text: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
Aur kehne lagey “Ek akela aadmi jo hum hi mein se hai kya ab hum uske peechey chalein? Iska ittibaah hum qabool karlein to iske maani yeh hongey ke hum behak gaye hain aur hamari aqal maari gayi hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

translations.text: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
Kya hamare darmiyan bas yahi ek shaks tha jispar khuda ka zikr nazil kiya gaya? nahin, balke yeh parle darje ka jhoota aur bar-khud galat (insolent liar)hai”

verses.text_uthmani: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

translations.text: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
(Humne apne paigambar se kaha) “ Kal hi inhein maaloom hua jata hai ke kaun parle darje ka jhoota aur bar khud galat hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

translations.text: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
Hum ountni (she-camel) ko inke liye fitna bana kar bhej rahe hain, ab zara sabr ke saath dekh ke inka kya anjaam hota hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

translations.text: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
Inko jata de ke paani inke aur ountni(she-camel) ke darmiyaan takseem hoga aur har ek apni baari ke din paani par aayega”

verses.text_uthmani: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

translations.text: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
Aakhir-e-kaar un logon ne apne aadmi ko pukara aur usne is kaam ka beda uthaya aur ountni (she-camel) ko maar dala

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.text: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
Phir dekh lo ke kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambeehat (warnings)

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

translations.text: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.

Humne unpar bas ek hi dhamaka chodha aur woh baade wale ki rondhi hui baad ke taraah bhus ho kar reh gaya. (Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, ab hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

translations.text: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
Lut ki qaum ne tambihat ko jhutlaya

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ

translations.text: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
Aur humne pattharao karne wali hawa is par bhej di. Sirf Lut ke ghar wale ussey mehfooz rahe

verses.text_uthmani: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

translations.text: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
Unko humne apne fazl se raat ke pichle pehar bacha kar nikal diya. Yeh jaza dete hai hum har us shaks ko jo shukar guzar hota hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

translations.text: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
Lut ne apni qaum ke logon ko hamari pakad se khabardaar kiya magar woh saari tambihat ko mashkuk (doubtful) samajh kar baaton mein udate rahey

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.text: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
Phir unhon ne usey apne mehmano ki hifazat se baaz rakhne ki koshish ki. Aakhir-e-kaar humne unki aankhein moond-di (blinded), ke chakkho ab mera azaab aur meri tambihaat ka maza

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

translations.text: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
Subah sawerey hi ek atal azaab ne unko aa liya

verses.text_uthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

translations.text: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
Chakkho mazaa ab mere azaab ka aur meri tambihaat ka

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.text: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, pas hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

translations.text: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
Aur aal-e-Firoun ke paas bhi tambihaat aayi thi

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

translations.text: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
Magar unhon ne hamari saari nishaniyon ko jhutla diya. Aakhir ko humne unhein pakda jis taraah koi zabardast qudrat wala pakadta hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

translations.text: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
Kya tumhare kuffar kuch un logon se behtar hain? Ya aasmani kitaabon mein tumhare liye koi maafi likhi hui hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

translations.text: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
Ya in logon ka kehna yeh hai ke hum ek mazboot jattha (jamaat) hain, apna bachao kar lengey

verses.text_uthmani: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

translations.text: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
Ankareeb yeh jattha(jamaat) shikhast kha jayega aur yeh sab peeth pheir kar bhaagte nazar aayenge

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

translations.text: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
Balke insey nimatne ke liye asal waade ka waqt to qayamat hai aur woh badi aafat aur zyaada talkh-saa-at (badi sakht aur kadwi cheez) hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

translations.text: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
Yeh mujrim log dar haqeeqat galat fehmi mein mubtala hain aur inki aqal maari gayi hai

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

translations.text: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
Jis roz yeh mooh ke bal aag mein ghaseetey jayenge us roz insey kaha jayega ke ab chakkho jahannum ki lapat ka maza

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ

translations.text: We have created all things in due measure;
Humne har cheez ek taqdeer ke saath paida ki hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

translations.text: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
Aur hamara hukum bas ek hi hukum hota hai aur palak jhapakate (twinkling of an eye) woh amal mein aa jata hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.text: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?
Tum jaisey bahut-soon ko hum halak kar chuke hain. Phir hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

translations.text: Everything they do is noted in their records:
Jo kuch inhon ne kiya hai woh sab daftaron (office) mein darj hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

translations.text: every action, great or small, is recorded.
Aur har choti badi baat likhi hui maujood hai

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

translations.text: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,
Nafarmani se parhez karne waley yaqeenan baaghon aur neharon mein hongey

verses.text_uthmani: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

translations.text: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
Sacchi izzat ki jagah, badey zeeh-iqtedar baadshah ke kareeb
